BiblicalUsage: The book of Esther names Aridatha once, among the ten sons of Haman who were hanged after the Jews defended themselves. His name sits in the middle of the list, and the verse says nothing more about him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the careful listing of all ten names shows God does not deal in vague judgments: each son of the man who plotted murder is named, and each one falls.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
